Dated : 22.05.2023
Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J. (Oral)
Applicant Bhupal Singh Danu, who is in judicial custody in F.I.R./Case Crime No.514 of 2021
(Special Sessions Trial No. 77 of 2021), under Sections 363, 376(3), 376(2)(n) of I.P.C. and Section
5(m)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, Police Station Haldwani, District -
Nainital, has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on file.

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused would submit that in her statement recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("The Code"), the prosecutrix has unequivocally stated that the applicant/accused was working with her father as Chef; that, she told her mother that she wants to marry the applicant/accused, thereafter, her family members beated her and applicant/accused, therefore, the applicant/accused left the job and went to Maharashtra; that, her parents damaged her phone, therefore, victim arranged another phone and contacted the applicant/accused with request to take her away from her family, however, the applicant/accused refused to do so as victim was not of the age; that, when her parents came to know about her contacting the applicant/accused, they again beated victim therefore, she tried to commit suicide;
that, on 23.09.2021 applicant came and victim went to petrol pump where from they went to Maharashtra and resided at Nagpur as husband wife.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text:
He would further refer to the statement Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85376220/
1 recorded under Section 161 of the Code (Page No. 46 of the Bail application), where the prosecutrix stated that the applicant/accused strongly refused to take her away but as her parents used to taunt her, therefore, she had left her home of her own.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: He would further refer to the medical examination report of the prosecutrix (Page 50 of the bail application), where she has written in her own hand that she was in a relationship with the applicant/accused and as she was bent upon to commit suicide, therefore, the applicant/accused had to keep her as she was in love with the applicant/accused and everything happened with her own consent.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text:
He would further refer to the testimony of the prosecutrix (Page No. 81 of the bail application) in the trial court, where she iterated the same in Para 34 and she said that she wanted to marry the applicant/accused and she herself asked the applicant/accused to take her away as her parents used to beat her.
5.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned State counsel strongly opposed the bail application, however, he admitted the above submissions made by the counsel for the applicant/accused in respect of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 of the Code, 164 of the Code before the Magistrate and her testimony before the trial court.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 6. In view of the above, but, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case before the trial court, this Court is of the view that this is a case fit for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 7 . The bail application is, accordingly, allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text:
8. Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond with two sureties in the amount of Rs. 40,000/- and personal bond in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 22.05.2023 Akash Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85376220/
